wire.t: Nov 23: Washington beat Cincinnati 22-20 on a Drew Stevens field goal with two seconds left, and Ja'Marr Chase scored 8.1, so NjigbaR Please! held on to beat Stroud of Turin 116.50 to 106.56. Chase needed 18.05.

Nov 23: Jacory Croskey-Merritt came off IR, started, and ran 13 times for 54 yards and a touchdown, 15.7 for Bijan is your daddy. Rachaad White (heel) was used mostly on third downs and didn't play in the third quarter; PFF doesn't see him as fantasy-viable going forward.
Nov 23: Derrick Henry is in the concussion protocol ahead of Baltimore's game against Houston, and Justice Hill is the fallback. Both are on the Ivefallenandicantgetup roster.

Nov 23: Saquon Barkley was limited on Philadelphia's estimated report (neck) after a late stinger and is expected to play Thanksgiving against Dallas below full strength. Dallas Goedert (shin) was also limited and is expected to play.
Nov 23: DJ Moore (knee) is a game-time decision for Buffalo's Thanksgiving game at Kansas City, and Kyren Williams (toe) was limited ahead of the Rams' Wednesday game against Green Bay.

Nov 23: Josh Jacobs is recovering from finger surgery and is unlikely to play Wednesday, and Kenneth Walker III (groin) didn't practice Monday after missing two games. Bhayshul Tuten is banged up, and Chris Rodriguez Jr. could see more work against Tennessee.
Nov 23: Antonio Williams caught 9 passes for 122 yards on Monday night, including two big gains on the winning drive. He scored 21.2 on the Nothing to see here bench.
Nov 24: No Week 12 waiver claims have processed yet, and the last league transaction was RedDevil904 dropping Roman Wilson on Sunday. Week 12 kicks off Wednesday night with Green Bay at the Rams.

stories.title: Achane in the Membrane loses by six hundredths, Bijan is your daddy comes back from 38 down on Monday night, and Llamageddon's 58.52 makes the Hall of Fame
stories.dek: Three Commanders erase a 38.18-point deficit, Mike Gesicki falls 0.06 short, Ja'Marr Chase falls 9.95 short, and there are now three 8-3 teams.
body: Monday night decided three games and made two people sick. Bijan is your daddy went into Monday down 101.26 to 63.08 to Ivefallenandicantgetup, and Jayden Daniels (17.06), Jacory Croskey-Merritt (15.7, a touchdown in his first game off IR) and Stefon Diggs (8.5) scored 41.26 to win 104.34 to 101.26. krunkdd had nobody left to play, Derrick Henry (19.1) and Justice Hill (17.6) on the bench, and a best possible lineup of 112.46 that wins. The Tampa Bay defense, a $12 claim, scored 0.0.

Achane in the Membrane went into Monday down 4.16 to Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, with Mike Gesicki against Chase Brown. Gesicki caught 5 passes for 77 yards, 12.7 points. Chase Brown scored 8.6. Final: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 128.22, Achane in the Membrane 128.16. Six hundredths. Devaughn Vele scored 14.6 on MakeItRains's bench while Adonai Mitchell started and scored 5.0, and the best possible lineup was 137.86. It's the fourth-highest score of the week and Achane in the Membrane is 4-7 with a 68-53 all-play record.

Stroud of Turin needed 18.05 from Ja'Marr Chase and got 8.1, so NjigbaR Please! won 116.50 to 106.56 behind Ashton Jeanty (28.9) and Travis Kelce (25.4). Lead Nagger beat Llamageddon 137.80 to 58.52, a 79.28-point margin and the biggest of the week. Llamageddon's 58.52 is the lowest score in the league this season and the fifth-lowest in league history, which bumps RedDevil904's 58.64 out of the Hall of Fame's basement. My Dad is Dead2 scored 143.22, the high of the week, and beat MY DAD IS DEAD (124.70, with Dak Prescott at 35.9) by 18.52, with Fernando Mendoza's 23.88 on my own bench behind Trevor Lawrence's 12.74. Wild Goose Chase beat Nothing to see here 108.16 to 90.94 while Antonio Williams scored 21.2 on ChuckJ10's bench.

Where that leaves us: NjigbaR Please!, Ivefallenandicantgetup and My Dad is Dead2 are all 8-3, Lead Nagger is 7-4, and Stroud of Turin, Wild Goose Chase and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered are 6-5 fighting over two spots. Three weeks left. MakeItRains won the Week 11 defense payout with the Chicago Bears (17.0), which is the most expensive consolation prize in league history.

stories.title: Three 8-3 teams, one first-place game: NjigbaR Please! and Ivefallenandicantgetup meet for the 1 seed
stories.dek: The simulator's seeds, the three-way tie at the top, and the 6-5 logjam fighting over two spots.
body: Three teams are 8-3. NjigbaR Please! leads on points (1,356.08), then Ivefallenandicantgetup (1,313.16) and My Dad is Dead2 (1,312.86), separated by 30 cents. Lead Nagger is 7-4 and leads the league in scoring at 133.59 a week with an 80-41 all-play record. Then come three 6-5 teams: Stroud of Turin (127.68 a week), Wild Goose Chase (125.79) and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered (118.70).

The Climax Bracket ran the last three weeks 20,000 times. Projected seeds: Ivefallenandicantgetup (9.8 wins), NjigbaR Please! (9.7), My Dad is Dead2 (9.2), Lead Nagger (9.0), Wild Goose Chase (7.8, 73% playoff odds) and Stroud of Turin (7.7, 76%). Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is first out at 42%, and Llamageddon (7%), Achane in the Membrane (7%) and Bijan is your daddy (5%) need help. Nothing to see here and MY DAD IS DEAD are out.

Week 12 sets it up. NjigbaR Please! is a 3.5-point favorite over Ivefallenandicantgetup for first place. Lead Nagger is a 14.5-point favorite over My Dad is Dead2, so the commish gets the league's best offense on Thanksgiving week. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered gets Llamageddon (2.5 points) and Wild Goose Chase gets MY DAD IS DEAD (23.5). Week 13 has Lead Nagger vs. Wild Goose Chase and My Dad is Dead2 vs. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered; Week 14 has My Dad is Dead2 vs. Stroud of Turin and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered vs. Wild Goose Chase.

Title odds if the seeds hold: Lead Nagger 24%, NjigbaR Please! 23%, Stroud of Turin 17%, Ivefallenandicantgetup 17%, Wild Goose Chase 12%, My Dad is Dead2 8%. The commish has the third-best record and the sixth-best title odds, which is the most My Dad is Dead2 sentence I have ever typed.

stories.title: Wednesday, Thursday and Friday games: the Week 12 injuries that hit league rosters before you get to set a lineup
stories.dek: Derrick Henry is in the protocol, Saquon Barkley and DJ Moore play on Thanksgiving banged up, and Kyren Williams plays Wednesday.
body: This is a short week with five early games: Green Bay at the Rams on Wednesday, then Buffalo at Kansas City, Chicago at Detroit and Dallas at Philadelphia on Thanksgiving, and Denver at Pittsburgh on Friday. Every team plays, so no byes this week. Check your lineup before Wednesday night.

Ivefallenandicantgetup: Derrick Henry is in the concussion protocol ahead of Baltimore's game against Houston on Sunday, with Justice Hill the fallback, and krunkdd has both. Bhayshul Tuten is banged up, and Chris Rodriguez Jr. (Nothing to see here bench) could see more work. Dalton Kincaid (thumb) is out per Sleeper. NjigbaR Please!: Kyren Williams (toe) was limited ahead of Wednesday's game, and Yahoo sees little reason to rely on him.

My Dad is Dead2: DJ Moore (knee) is a game-time decision for Thursday at Kansas City. MY DAD IS DEAD: Saquon Barkley was limited with a neck issue after a stinger and is expected to play below full strength; Seth McGowan (hamstring) is out per Sleeper. Stroud of Turin: Dallas Goedert (shin) was limited and is expected to play Thursday. Lead Nagger: Kenneth Walker III (groin) didn't practice Monday after missing two games, and Jordan Addison (thumb) is out per Sleeper.

Breece'sBurdenDeflowered: Josh Jacobs is unlikely to play Wednesday after finger surgery, and A.J. Brown (hamstring) is out per Sleeper. Llamageddon: Brock Bowers (ankle) is out per Sleeper, and Drake London (head) and Juwan Johnson (hamstring) are questionable. Wild Goose Chase: Drake Maye (ankle) is out per Sleeper and Tyjae Spears and RJ Harvey are on IR. Achane in the Membrane: Marvin Harrison Jr. (hamstring) is out per Sleeper.

feature.title: Week 11: six hundredths, a 38-point Monday night comeback, and 58.52
body: The league averaged 112.37 in Week 11, and three games were decided on Monday night by players from one 22-20 game in Landover. Bijan is your daddy trailed Ivefallenandicantgetup 101.26 to 63.08 going into the night and won 104.34 to 101.26 behind Jayden Daniels (17.06), Jacory Croskey-Merritt (15.7) and Stefon Diggs (8.5). FatMikeR picked up Croskey-Merritt on Nov 18 off IR and he scored a touchdown in his first game back. krunkdd's best possible lineup was 112.46, with Derrick Henry (19.1) and Justice Hill (17.6) on the bench, and Bhayshul Tuten (8.3) left hurt in the fourth quarter.

Achane in the Membrane and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered played to 128.16 and 128.22. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered led by 4.16 going into Monday; Mike Gesicki gave MakeItRains 12.7 and Chase Brown gave rtmcruise 8.6, and the difference is the six hundredths. Cam Ward scored 23.22 and Mike Evans 22.9 for the winners. MakeItRains started Adonai Mitchell (5.0) over Devaughn Vele (14.6), and the best possible lineup (137.86) wins by almost ten. It's the closest game in the league this year.

Stroud of Turin needed 18.05 from Ja'Marr Chase and got 8.1 on 5 catches for 31 yards, so NjigbaR Please! won 116.50 to 106.56. RedDevil904 also left Aaron Rodgers (15.98) on the bench behind C.J. Stroud (21.46), which was the right call, and Pat Freiermuth (9.0) on the bench behind Dallas Goedert (4.8), which wasn't. Lead Nagger hammered Llamageddon 137.80 to 58.52 behind Jonah Coleman (34.9) and Emmett Johnson (24.3), and dcrabb's 58.52 is the fifth-lowest score in league history.

My Dad is Dead2 scored 143.22, the best of the week, and beat MY DAD IS DEAD by 18.52 to cover the 16.5-point line. I started Trevor Lawrence (12.74) over Fernando Mendoza (23.88), and I'd like that one back. Wild Goose Chase covered against Nothing to see here 108.16 to 90.94 with Tyjae Spears at 0.0 in the FLEX, and ChuckJ10's best lineup (123.34) wins that game too, with Antonio Williams (21.2) on the bench. Week 11's defense payout goes to MakeItRains for the Chicago Bears' 17.0.

rankings.take: Beat Llamageddon 137.80 to 58.52 behind Jonah Coleman (34.9) and Emmett Johnson (24.3). 133.59 a week and an 80-41 all-play record, both the best in the league, and the simulator's title favorite at 24%. Next: My Dad is Dead2, favored by 14.5.

columns.title: SIX HUNDREDTHS. Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner on the Achane in the Membrane loss
columns.dek: A 14.6 on the bench, a 5.0 in the lineup, and a season that died by less than a single yard.
body: I have sat in this press box through every kind of loss this league has to offer. Blowouts. Bad beats. A guy who started a kicker on bye in 2021. And I have NEVER been as mad as I was at 11:30 Monday night. Achane in the Membrane 128.16. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 128.22. SIX. HUNDREDTHS. OF. A. POINT.

Here's how it happened. MakeItRains went into Monday down 4.16 with Mike Gesicki against Chase Brown. Gesicki catches 5 balls for 77 yards, 12.7 points. Chase Brown gets 8.6. That's a 4.10-point swing on a 4.16-point deficit. Gesicki did his job! Gesicki did MORE than his job! And it's not enough, because the damage was done on SUNDAY.

Devaughn Vele scored 14.6 points. ON THE BENCH. Adonai Mitchell started and scored 5.0. That's 9.6 points, MakeItRains. NINE POINT SIX. You needed SIX HUNDREDTHS. The best possible lineup was 137.86! You don't lose that game, you win it by almost TEN, and you're 5-6 instead of 4-7, and I'm writing about something else!

And it HURTS because this team is GOOD. 126.19 a week, third-best in the league. A 68-53 all-play record, fourth-best. Jahmyr Gibbs scored 27.8, Patrick Mahomes 24.96. And they are 4-7 with 7% playoff odds, sitting behind a 6-5 team that scores 118.70 a week. That is a CRIME. That is the most unjust record in this league, and the guy who did it to them is in the mirror.

Now I'm HEARING things, and I want to be careful here. Word in the press box is MakeItRains has filed a formal petition to have Sleeper score to the thousandths, and when that was denied, he filed a second one asking for the game to be decided by which team has the better name. Sources also say he has been seen measuring the gap between Gesicki's last catch and a first down with a piece of string. None of this is confirmed. All of it should be.
Week 12 is Stroud of Turin as a 1.5-point dog in the highest total of the week. MakeItRains, set the lineup. Then CHECK THE LINEUP. Then have SOMEONE ELSE check it. SIX HUNDREDTHS!

columns.title: Dick Fitzwell: Ivefallenandicantgetup is 8-3 and soft
columns.dek: A 38-point lead, nobody left to play, and a loss. That's a team that's been winning on schedule, not on film.
body: Put the tape on. Ivefallenandicantgetup goes into Monday night up 101.26 to 63.08 on Bijan is your daddy. Thirty-eight points. Nobody left to play. And they lose 104.34 to 101.26 to three Washington Commanders. You don't lose that game. You don't lose that game in Pop Warner.

Here's the film. Derrick Henry scored 19.1 on the bench. Justice Hill, the $14 claim, scored 17.6 on the bench. The Tampa Bay defense, a $12 claim, started and scored 0.0. Bhayshul Tuten got hurt in the fourth quarter after 8.3, and that's football, I'm not putting that on krunkdd. But the best possible lineup was 112.46, and that wins by eight.

And it's not one week. Ivefallenandicantgetup is 8-3 with a 64-57 all-play record. That's sixth in the league. Lead Nagger is 80-41. Stroud of Turin is 72-49. Achane in the Membrane, 4-7, is 68-53. krunkdd has scored 119.38 a week, sixth-best, and has eight wins because the schedule kept serving him teams that were having a bad day. That's soft. That's a 1 seed with a glass jaw.

I'm told, and this comes from someone who sat next to him at a sports bar, that krunkdd sets his lineup by having his dog pick between two tennis balls with player names written on them, and the dog has been on a cold streak since the Bye Week Incident. I'm also told he believes the Tampa Bay defense will score more points if he stops looking at it. None of this is confirmed. The 0.0 is.

Now it gets real. NjigbaR Please! for first place, and Ivefallenandicantgetup is a 3.5-point dog. Henry is in the concussion protocol, so krunkdd has to decide between Henry and Hill with real information for once. This is the game that tells you if this team is a contender or a schedule. My money's on the schedule running out.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's seven Thanksgiving lineup rules, which I have tested on zero people
columns.dek: Wednesday, Thursday and Friday games, and I've got a system. It's a bad system.
body: Week 12 starts Wednesday night with Green Bay at the Rams, then three games on Thanksgiving and one on Friday. That means you have to set your lineup before you've digested anything. Lucky for you, I'm in the lawn chair with a plan. Here it is, numbered, so you know it's science.

1. Start whoever played on Monday night. Jayden Daniels, Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Stefon Diggs scored 41.26 on Monday to beat Ivefallenandicantgetup by 3.08. Monday night players are clearly the best players, and they've had the least rest, which means they're the most warmed up. 2. Bench any tight end named Mike. Mike Gesicki scored 12.7 on Monday night and still lost by 0.06. That's a cursed name. If your tight end is named Mike, you're down six hundredths before kickoff. 3. Lead Nagger scores 133.59 a week, the most in the league, so if you play Lead Nagger (hi, Bill_Buttlicker), just don't. Forfeit. You can't lose by 14.5 if you don't show up.

4. Always start the player on your bench who scored the most last week. Fernando Mendoza scored 23.88 on the My Dad is Dead2 bench. Antonio Williams scored 21.2 on the Nothing to see here bench. Ladd McConkey scored 20.7 on the MY DAD IS DEAD bench. All three teams lost or nearly did. The bench is where the points go to hide. Just start your whole bench. 5. If your defense scored 0.0 last week, like Tampa Bay for Ivefallenandicantgetup and Minnesota for Stroud of Turin, it's due. Zeros are like rain. You can't have two in a row.

6. FatMikeR has $200 of FAAB and 5% playoff odds. Spend it all on one guy. Doesn't matter who. Bid $200 on a kicker. This league doesn't even use kickers. That's how you send a message. 7. Set your lineup Tuesday and then never look at it again. Looking at a lineup is how second-guessing happens.

I'm hearing, and I want to stress that I heard this from a man in a neighboring lawn chair who was also asleep, that Pudge247 is so confident about Lead Nagger that he plans to set his lineup by throwing a turkey leg at the screen, and that Bill_Buttlicker is planning to counter by starting two quarterbacks in the FLEX, which isn't allowed. None of this is confirmed, and Sleeper won't let you do the second one. I checked.
Follow all seven rules and I guarantee you'll set a lineup. That's the only guarantee. Happy Thanksgiving week from the lawn chair.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: 58.52 is actually Llamageddon's best score of the season, if you look at it correctly
columns.dek: I've run the numbers on the fifth-lowest score in league history, and my spreadsheet says it's a breakout.
body: Everyone is looking at Llamageddon's 58.52 in Week 11 and seeing the lowest score in the league this season and the fifth-lowest in league history. I'm looking at it and seeing the most efficient fantasy performance of 2026. Let me walk you through my model.

First, efficiency. Llamageddon started nine players and two of them, Brock Bowers and Ja'Kobi Lane, scored 0.0. That means seven players produced all 58.52 points, or 8.36 points per producing player. Lead Nagger needed all nine to get 137.80, which is 15.31 per player, so Llamageddon is clearly the more efficient team per zero. My spreadsheet calls this metric Points Per Non-Zero Contributor Adjusted For Zeros, and Llamageddon leads the league.

Second, the bench. dcrabb's best possible lineup was 65.52, so he only left 7.00 points on the bench. My Dad is Dead2 left 11.14 points on the bench while scoring 143.22. Achane in the Membrane left 9.70 and lost by 0.06. In my model, a 58.52 with a nearly perfect lineup is a more disciplined 58.52 than any score above it. Discipline wins championships. My Dad is Dead2 has left 196.06 points on its bench this season, most in the league, and is 8-3. I don't know what that does to my model and I've stopped asking.

Third, trajectory. Llamageddon is 5-6 with a 61-60 all-play record, which is above .500. Rounded to the nearest whole number of standard deviations, that's a playoff team. The simulator says 7%. The simulator, unlike me, doesn't have a spreadsheet tab called 'vibes.' Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is a 2.5-point favorite this week, which in my model means Llamageddon is a 2.5-point favorite in the opposite direction.

Sources say, and by sources I mean a pivot table I built at 2 a.m., that dcrabb has been secretly tanking to lower expectations so he can win the Aniston as a 6 seed by being underestimated, and that the 58.52 was a carefully calculated number chosen to stay just above the league's all-time worst. I'm also told he has a whiteboard with the word 'Bowers' crossed out eleven times. None of this is confirmed. The pivot table may also be broken.
Final verdict: 58.52 is a breakout. I'll be updating my model after Week 12, assuming my spreadsheet opens.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

items.dek: First place, the projected 1 and 2 seeds, and two banged-up running backs.
body: On paper this is the game of the week. NjigbaR Please! and Ivefallenandicantgetup are both 8-3, first and second on the projected seed list, and the winner leads the league with two weeks left. NjigbaR Please! scores 123.28 a week with a 73-48 all-play record; Ivefallenandicantgetup scores 119.38 with a 64-57 all-play record. One team has been good; the other has been good at Sundays.

The gap is 3.90, so the line is NjigbaR Please! by 3.5, a 54% favorite, with a 242.7 total. No nudge: there are no byes this week, Kyren Williams (toe) was limited before Wednesday's game, and Derrick Henry is in the concussion protocol, with Justice Hill behind him on the same roster.
